name: Open Library
author: Chronicle Contributors
description: Book and author metadata from Open Library: descriptions, covers, authors with biographies and photos, subjects, ratings, series where Open Library has it, and cross-reference ids. No API key or account required. A second source beside Hardcover for books and audiobooks.
fixMatchHint: Enter an Open Library id (OL16114008W for a book, OL6982995A for an author), an openlibrary.org URL, an ISBN-10 or ISBN-13, or goodreads: followed by a Goodreads book id.

background_tasks.description: Looks up Open Library metadata for books, audiobooks and authors that have not been enriched by Open Library yet.
Re-fetches all Open Library metadata to pick up corrected descriptions, covers and ratings. Slow on a large library.
